affectedPrivateRelease.ownerReportedFailure: Export refused after choosing a new filename; same generic save failure recorded in the release build receipt

cause: Tauri 2.11.5 sets binary IPC Content-Type to application/octet-stream. The app incorrectly used that transport header as document MIME, so the native PDF/JSON save handler rejected the first chunk.
repair: Keep binary Content-Type application/octet-stream and carry the document MIME in x-pdfmason-content-type. Independently validate both headers against the native selection kind; preserve all existing raw-body, size, header, token, offset, completion, cancellation and destination/overwrite checks.
